notes:
Status: Closed - lost to Together. Key context below.

Deal background:
- Vertical: enterprise contact center vendor building a multi-tenant conversational layer for customers.
- Primary ask: private/VPC or on-prem option due to regulated customer base (financial + healthcare).
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 80ms for chat; throughput 60-100 rps per tenant expected.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; looking at multi-year reserved pricing.

What happened / reasons lost:
- Competitor win: Together offered an integrated private deployment + managed infra relationship with Zephyr's current MSP; lower near-term TCO in procurement model.
- Security/timing: Zephyr required HSM-backed KMS and ISO audit artifacts on an accelerated timeline. Our private deployment NDA + on-prem packaging timeline was estimated 10-12 weeks — procurement couldn't wait.
- Budget: CFO announced a Q1 hiring/budget freeze affecting new platform licenses; pushed evaluation into indefinite hold if no material cost delta.
- Champion attrition: primary internal champion (Dir. of ML Ops) left during vendor evaluation window after org reorg — lost momentum.
- Developer feedback: Replicate was used by a small internal dev team for quick prototyping, but they cited limited scale; still preferred vendor relationship from Together for enterprise rollouts.

POC summary:
- POC ran for 3 weeks: integration with chat stack + sample traffic. Performance met latency targets in hosted mode but required extra ops for on-prem config.
- Security ticket SEC-1198 flagged need for HSM and longer retention of audit logs (3 years) — critical blocker for compliance/finance customers.

Sales notes / next actions (finalized):
- Won't pursue active opportunity this quarter; mark closed-lost.
- Send formal loss review to sales leadership and product to capture gaps (private packaging, faster KMS/HSM guidance, partner story).
- Share POC artifacts to drive / archive.
- Ask Zephyr for permission to run a short exit survey on why Together chosen (ask buyer: procurement@zephyrconv.ai).

Quotes / call excerpts:
- "We like Redwood's performance but the procurement team needs a partner that can plug into our MSP and guarantee private infra — Together had that contract already." — Procurement lead
- "Timeline was the killer; security wanted HSM now, we can't extend the pilot indefinitely." — Dir. of Engineering (paraphrase)
outcome_reason_summary: Lost to Together due to pre-existing MSP relationship + faster on-prem/private deployment option, compounded by Q1 budget freeze and loss of internal champion. Security timeline (HSM/KMS) was a proximate blocker.
internal_recommendations: 1) Build an accelerated private deploy playbook for enterprise MSP integrations. 2) Create a security artifacts pack (HSM/KMS integration guide + audit templates) to shorten review cycles. 3) Product: evaluate a hosted-to-onprem migration template to reduce ops lift. 4) Follow up with Zephyr in 6 months for re-evaluation.
